subject: Pilot kickoff: scope, access gates, success metrics & owners
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@ellipsedata.com>, Sofia Patel <sofia.patel@ellipsedata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T15:18:00Z
Subject: Pilot kickoff: scope, access gates, success metrics & owners

Thanks again for taking the time today — quick recap and proposed next steps to get the pilot running next week. Short version up top, details below.

TL;DR
- Problem: unpredictable inference latency at scale + cost spikes when model traffic bursts
- Goal: 2-week pilot to validate p95 latency < 250ms for common flows and reduce per-token unit cost by ~30% vs current setup
- Scope: 3 production-like prompt families (support triage, search rerank, and short-form summarization), 100k tokens/day average, dedicated test pool on Redwood Dedicated
- Next steps: customer to provide sample prompt set + service account; Redwood provides pilot contract, Dedicated config, and success criteria doc

Pain points you shared
- Search reranker: 300–600ms tail latency right now with frequent spikes during business hours
- Cost: heavy token volumes for reranking are painful; pricing unpredictability during peak
- Quality guardrails: you need tooling to compare model outputs (side-by-side) and measure hallucination for the summarization use-case

Proposed pilot scope (attached: pilot_scope_v1.pdf + sample_prompt_set.json)
- Duration: 2 weeks (measurement window after warm-up)
- Traffic: synthetic replay of 100k tokens/day (you can also choose a sampled replay)
- Models: 1 base model + 1 quantized variant for fallbacks
- Success metrics: p95 latency < 250ms; mean tokens/sec throughput for batch >= X (we'll measure); baseline quality regression < 3% on your eval set

Owners & roles
- Ellipsed Data: Alex (PM, primary), Sofia (Data Eng, access + sample data)
- Redwood: Marissa (CSM/eng lead), Ben (solutions engineer)

Access & setup checklist (what we need from you)
1) Service account or OIDC role for Redwood to call your test environment (or we can run in Redwood-managed VPC)
2) Sample prompt set (attached) and a small labeled eval set for regression checks
3) Network allowlist (we gave two region endpoints in the attached scope)
4) Decision on whether to use replay or live traffic sampling

Logistics / timeline
- Please confirm access by EOD Wed (2027-05-19)
- Redwood to provide Dedicated config + cost estimate within 24h after access
- Target pilot start: Mon 2027-05-24 (if access confirmed)

Ask: Can you confirm the two owners above and whether Ellipsed will provide a service account or prefer Redwood-managed VPC?

Thanks — I attached the scope doc and sample prompt set. Happy to hop on a 15m call if helpful.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0142

[attachment: sample_prompt_set.json (JSON, 48KB)]

From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@ellipsedata.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sofia Patel <sofia.patel@ellipsedata.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T17:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: scope, access gates, success metrics & owners

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the high-level items and a few clarifications from our side:

1) Owners: confirmed — I (Alex) will be the PM lead and Sofia will manage data/access. We'll loop in our infra contact (Jin Park) once we decide between service account vs Redwood-managed VPC.
2) Timeline: aiming for May 24 is fine, we just need the cost estimate to clear with finance.
3) Eval set: we'll share a 500-record labeled sample for the summarization use-case by EOD Friday (2027-05-19).
4) Security: we will want a SOC2 report and a short note on data retention during the pilot. Can you attach those?

Questions:
- Do you anticipate any egress or firewall config changes if we keep the testing in our VPC?
- For the quantized fallback, will you run both variants in parallel during the measurement window or do a sequential A/B?

We can do a quick 20m sync Thursday if you want to walk the attached scope together.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Wu
Product Manager, Ellipsed Data
alex.wu@ellipsedata.com | +1 206-555-0199

To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>

Folks — looping you both in to start the internal runbook. Highlights from the customer: sample eval set arriving by EOD 19th, needs SOC2 and retention note, prefers May 24 start if finance signs off on estimate.

Ben — can you draft a Dedicated pool proposal (GPU type + node count + warm-up plan) and a quick cost_estimate_q2.xlsx for Alex to share with finance? We should include an option for Redwood-managed VPC vs customer VPC and note any egress/firewall steps.
Connor — please flag if there are any quota or infra constraints for a 2-week pilot starting 5/24 and estimate time to provision.

Action items (internal):
- Ben: Dedicated config + cost estimate (by EOD 5/18)
- Connor: Provisioning time + any infra runbook (by EOD 5/18)
- Marissa: Send SOC2 + data retention blurb to Alex (ASAP)

I'll attach a quick template for the runbook in case you want to reuse it.

—
Marissa

Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: scope, access gates, success metrics & owners

Marissa / team — draft attached (redwood_dedicated_proposal.xlsx + cost_estimate_q2.xlsx). Summary below:

Proposal summary
- Cluster: 4x A5000-equivalent nodes (prelim); autoscale capped for pilot to control cost
- Baseline throughput: expected to hit target throughput for the 100k tokens/day synthetic replay with continuous batching
- Warm-up: 24h synthetic replay to prime caches and KV cache behavior
- Quantized variant: will run side-by-side on a smaller node pool for fallback comparison; results collected via our eval harness

Cost estimate (high level)
- Option A (customer VPC): estimated $6,200 for 2-week pilot (compute + managed infra)
- Option B (Redwood-managed VPC): estimated $7,400 for 2-week pilot (includes managed infra + egress overhead)

Attachments: redwood_dedicated_proposal.xlsx, cost_estimate_q2.xlsx

Notes: Connor — provisioning ETA looks like 36–48h once we get a signed MD. If Alex confirms, I'll start provisioning and share exact endpoint IPs for allowlisting.

—
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com

Thanks — Alex
